plan: To preserve capital, sell all leveraged ETFs (METU, SOXL, MUU, MSFU, PLTU, SPAL) to zero.
Trim QQQI to 20% to meet the single-name concentration limit.
This strategy prioritizes safety and reduces overall portfolio risk significantly.
Maintain a substantial cash buffer by reducing exposure to volatile assets.
conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for capital preservation with a potential target of ~1.5% per month. It significantly reduces drawdown risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration. Expect lower volatility and more stable returns, but also limited upside potential.

plan: Trim all leveraged ETFs (METU, SOXL, MUU, MSFU, PLTU, SPAL) to small positions to reduce overall leverage.
Reduce QQQI to 25% to comply with the single-name concentration limit.
Buy OXY at 4% as a new position, leveraging a strong scanner setup.
This approach balances growth potential with a focus on managing risk and diversification.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5% per month by blending growth with risk management. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding a high-quality new setup. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, with a focus on sustainable growth.

plan: Increase exposure to leveraged ETFs (METU, SOXL, MUU, MSFU, PLTU, SPAL) to lean into growth.
Trim QQQI to 25% to meet the single-name concentration limit.
Buy OXY at 6% as a new position, capitalizing on a strong scanner setup.
This strategy uses leverage and concentration to target higher growth, accepting increased risk.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% per month by maximizing exposure to leveraged ETFs and high-scoring setups. This approach significantly increases both potential upside and drawdown risk. Leveraged ETFs experience daily decay and rebalancing, which can lead to rapid losses if not managed with strict stop discipline. Expect high volatility and be prepared for larger potential drawdowns.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (METU, SOXL, MUU, MSFU, PLTU, SPAL) to zero to reduce risk.
Increase QQQI to 30% to prioritize steady monthly distributions.
This plan focuses on generating income and maintaining a low-drawdown profile.
The goal is to park cash for yield, accepting lower growth potential.
income.read: This income plan targets ~1% per month by rotating into income-generating ETFs. It prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income over growth, cutting all leveraged and high-beta single names. Distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is not a savings account.
